questions.solution:
Find the differences between successive terms:

• 677 - 672 = 5

• 686 - 677 = 9

• 699 - 686 = 13

• 716 - 699 = 17

The differences increase by 4 each time. The next difference should be 17 + 4 = 21. Therefore, the next term = 716 + 21 = 737.

Option (d) is the correct answer.
